description: Creative-repair demo scenarios from demo-candidate-factory 20260723-001. Curated for quality: nefarious topology-level defects on complex workflows, excluding trivial upscale widget tweaks.

scenarios.title: The second video output looks much worse than the first
scenarios.query: The second video output looks much worse than the first – details are blurry and it lacks the sharp style I applied in the first branch.
scenarios.description: Repairs a missing LoRA second branch fault in an LTX video workflow. The second refinement pass fails to activate its intended LoRA, producing degraded output.

scenarios.title: The image looks like it's deliberately avoiding the description
scenarios.query: The image looks like it's deliberately avoiding the description. For example, I wrote 'a beautiful sunset' but the result is a dark indoor scene with no trace of sunset.
scenarios.description: Repairs a positive prompt wired to the negative conditioning slot in a Flux2 workflow. The model inverts the intent, producing the opposite of what was described.

scenarios.title: No matter how many times I queue, the first output image is always exactly the same
scenarios.query: No matter how many times I queue, the first output image is always exactly the same, even though I expected variation.
scenarios.description: Repairs a noise randomize turned off fault in a Flux2 workflow. The seed widget is set to a fixed value instead of randomize, so every run produces identical output.

scenarios.title: The cloned voice sounds unnatural, with strange pauses and emphasis
scenarios.query: The cloned voice sounds unnatural, with strange pauses and emphasis. It delivers the correct text but the speaker's prosody is all over the place.
scenarios.description: Repairs a reference text mismatch fault in a Qwen3 TTS voice clone workflow. The reference text does not match the target text, causing unnatural prosody.

scenarios.title: Something's off with the generation — the result comes out wrong, like the prompt guidance is flipped
scenarios.query: Something's off with the generation — the result comes out wrong, like the prompt guidance is flipped — the negative prompt seems to be driving the image instead of the positive Can you look at the workflow and fix it so the result comes out right?
scenarios.description: Repairs a conditioning polarity swap fault. The positive and negative conditioning inputs are reversed, causing the model to generate the inverse of the intended style.

scenarios.title: Every image comes out horizontally squished
scenarios.query: All my images are squished horizontally — people look short and fat, objects are distorted, even though I’m using a square-ish prompt. It’s like the aspect ratio is being collapsed.
scenarios.description: Repairs a latent width/height mismatch fault in an AuraFlow/SD3 text-to-image workflow. The empty latent was created with width and height swapped, so the model samples a distorted canvas that decodes into a squished image.

scenarios.title: The generated audio is completely silent
scenarios.query: The generated audio is completely silent – no speech at all, just a blank audio file. The workflow runs without errors but nothing comes out.
scenarios.description: Repairs an empty TTS prompt fault in a Qwen3 voice-clone workflow. The target text widget was left blank, so the synthesizer has nothing to speak and emits silence.

scenarios.title: The result looks like the prompt guidance is flipped
scenarios.query: Something’s off with the generation — the result comes out wrong, like the prompt guidance is flipped — the negative prompt seems to be driving the image instead of the positive. Can you fix it so the result matches what I described?
scenarios.description: Repairs a conditioning polarity swap fault in a Flux2 workflow. The positive and negative conditioning inputs to the sampler were reversed, so the model is guided away from the intended prompt and toward the negative prompt.

scenarios.title: The LoRA style never shows up, and the prompt feels inverted
scenarios.query: I loaded a style LoRA but the result doesn’t reflect it at all, and the whole image feels like it’s being pushed away from my prompt rather than toward it. The conditioning seems to be fighting the LoRA.
scenarios.description: Repairs a conditioning polarity swap fault on a LoRA-loaded AuraFlow workflow. Positive and negative conditioning were wired to the wrong sampler inputs, so the LoRA’s style contribution is suppressed and the model inverts the prompt intent.

scenarios.title: The voice reads my English text with a heavy foreign accent
scenarios.query: The audio file is created, but the voice pronounces the English text with a heavy Chinese accent and completely mangled phonetics. The words are almost unrecognisable. It should be speaking English.
scenarios.description: Repairs a TTS language mismatch fault in a Qwen3 voice-design workflow. The language widget was set to Chinese while the target text is English, so the synthesizer maps English phonemes through Chinese pronunciation and produces an incomprehensible accent.

scenarios.title: My LTX video lost its refinement pass — the output is rougher than before
scenarios.query: I removed the refinement pass from my two-stage LTX video workflow and now the output is rougher and less polished — it lost the second quality pass the two-stage pipeline used to apply. Can you add the refinement pass back where it belongs so the polished output is restored?
scenarios.description: Re-adds the second-stage refinement sampler in a two-stage LTX-2.3 video pipeline (base generation followed by a refinement pass at higher latent resolution). Removing the refinement stage degrades output to single-stage quality; the agent reconstructs the refinement pass (a second SamplerCustomAdvanced with its ManualSigmas schedule, wired into the latent-upscale and decode chain) using provenance evidence from the original workflow.

scenarios.title: The upscale step vanished — my images lost their detail
scenarios.query: I had an upscale/resize step in this image workflow and it’s gone — the final image comes out lower resolution than it should, it lost the extra detail the upscale pass used to add. Can you add that step back where it belongs so the output is restored?
scenarios.description: Additive restore: the upscaler node was removed from a basic image-upscale workflow, leaving a resolution gap. The fixer re-adds the ImageScale node and rewires it so the output regains the intended resolution (verdict: alternative_repair).

scenarios.title: The fast Lightning generation path vanished — it's slow again
scenarios.query: The fast Lightning path has disappeared. This Qwen workflow now behaves like the slow base model instead of the quick four-step setup I was using. Please restore the accelerated generation path without changing my prompt or output size.
scenarios.description: Additive restore: the Lightning acceleration slice (LoRA loader + model-sampling + step-routing switch) was removed from a Qwen image workflow, so it fell back to slow base-model sampling. The fixer re-adds the accelerated multi-node path so generation is fast again. Verdict: accepted.

scenarios.title: Text-to-song generation produces no audio output
scenarios.query: The ACE-Step models still load, but the actual song-generation path is gone and nothing reaches the audio output. Please restore text-to-song generation so the prompt produces a finished, saveable track again.
scenarios.description: Additive restore: the song-generation head (empty audio latent → text encode → conditioning → sampler → audio VAE decode) was removed from an ACE-Step workflow, so nothing reaches the audio output. The fixer re-adds the generation path so the prompt produces a finished, saveable track. Verdict: accepted.
